column1: # WORLDEND SYNDROME 1.0.0 (base v0): scaffold macOS profile.
# Unity 2017.4.17f1 IL2CPP + CRIWARE. See README.md. Memory numbers are the
# NPDM / profile_guess starting point (sys_resource=0); a heap check may revise them.
# rtld is the loader; main imports from subsdk0 (movie) and sdk.
# Extraction is atomic; check its root without shipping an original asset path.
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0). Main may SetHeapSize.
# Starting layout matches profile_guess for a 4 GB application pool without VA memory.
# Modules are 70 MB; default 64 MB used-memory made SetHeapSize(pool-used) overflow the pool.
# Unity 2017.4 traps unless NVN minor > 311 (Cuphead / Ori). SDK 6 would otherwise report 53.313.
